description: Fork of exp428. Single mechanism: per-row visit-count gradient normalization in soft backward. After the index_add_ scatter, each (table, row) weight gradient is divided by its visit count, converting SUM-over-visiting-tokens to MEAN. Equalizes effective update magnitude across rows regardless of visit imbalance. Hot rows get smaller (averaged) updates; cold rows visited once unchanged; dead rows still zero. Hypothesis: late-layer dead-row pathology is gradient-magnitude starvation; equalization lifts ceiling.
